data.name: Cordell
data.gender_notes: Cordell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word cordus, meaning 'heart'. The name Cordell is derived from the Latin word cordellus, meaning 'little heart'. It symbolizes strength, dexterity, and courage. In the Middle Ages, Cordell was a popular name for boys born into knightly families, reflecting the virtues of chivalry and honor. The name Cordell carries the meaning “Dexterity, strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cordell usually hope their child will grow to embody dexterity, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
